blocks.p: While your character carries out a timed action, such as reading a book, a bar over the character shows how far the action has run. Figure 26-1 shows the bar as the game draws it.

caption: Figure 26-1
The action bar as the game draws it.

blocks.p: The *Action bar* setting on the *ZeD setup* page of *Options* chooses how the bar is drawn: *Verbose*, in words, or *Simple*, as ten segments. Figure 26-2 shows *Verbose*.
In the verbose bar the action and the item are written out over the character, and a framed strip under them fills as the action runs.

caption: Figure 26-2
The verbose bar while reading a book.

blocks.p: A long name is shortened, as the book's title is here.

marks.text: ZeD: the action and the item in words, over the character.
The framed strip fills as the action runs.

sticky.text: Set the action bar in Options, ZeD setup.
